[SWS_EM_CONSTR_00001]
Note:
No use-case has been identified for an
Execution Dependency
on other
Process States
, i.e.
Idle
or
Terminating
, and therefore these are not supported
for
Execution Dependency
configuration. See also [SWS_EM_CONSTR_01744].
